run_belief_propagation: run belief propagation inference with BP(bp_state, temperature) to get a BeliefPropagation inferer
run_bp_with_diffs: run belief propagation with run_with_diffs to monitor convergence via message deltas per iteration
run_bp_single: run belief propagation with run to execute num_iters of message passing with damping
pass_var_to_fac_messages: pass variable to factor messages by computing vtof_msgs from ftov_msgs and evidence
normalize_and_clip_msgs: normalize and clip factor to variable messages for numeric stability in loopy graphs
get_marginals: get normalized marginal probabilities from beliefs using sum-product or max-product estimates
